raw.query: WITH current_dim AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_current_runs FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true), stored AS (SELECT (detail->'1min'->>'n')::int AS stored_n, (detail->'1min'->>'cov90')::double precision AS stored_coverage, 1.0 - (detail->'1min'->>'cov90')::double precision AS stored_exceedance_rate FROM provenance.quantile_coverage WHERE model = 'chronos_cov' AND signal = 'images'), raw AS (SELECT f.h, f.step, f.y_true, f.p90 FROM current_dim d CROSS JOIN provenance.forecast f WHERE f.model = 'chronos' AND f.mode = 'cov' AND f.resolution = '1min' AND f.variate = 'images' AND f.origin >= 8076), by_horizon AS (SELECT h, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE y_true > p90)::double precision / COUNT(*) AS exceedance_rate FROM raw GROUP BY h), pooled AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS denominator_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT step) AS distinct_image_bins, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE y_true > p90) AS exceedances, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE y_true > p90)::double precision / COUNT(*) AS exact_exceedance_rate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p90 IS NULL) AS null_p90 FROM raw) SELECT s.stored_n, s.stored_coverage, s.stored_exceedance_rate, p.denominator_rows, p.distinct_image_bins, p.exceedances, p.exact_exceedance_rate, p.null_p90, MIN(b.exceedance_rate) AS min_horizon_rate, MAX(b.exceedance_rate) AS max_horizon_rate, d.n_current_runs FROM current_dim d CROSS JOIN stored s CROSS JOIN pooled p CROSS JOIN by_horizon b GROUP BY s.stored_n, s.stored_coverage, s.stored_exceedance_rate, p.denominator_rows, p.distinct_image_bins, p.exceedances, p.exact_exceedance_rate, p.null_p90, d.n_current_runs
raw.evidence: The raw common-span Chronos-covariate 1-minute image forecasts reproduce the stored rate with 225 exceedances among 2004 unique bins and no null p90 values.
